comment: Bảng domain của `jjv video` (pipeline VIDEO theo từng shot, spec docs/specs/2026-10-31-video-engine-per-shot.md). Code engine không nêu tên domain: template H3, port graph, lưới frame, seed gốc và chính sách upscale của từng domain đều nằm ở đây. Domain không có trong allowed_domains bị từ chối trước khi ghi bất kỳ file nào. Backend upscale khác `none` cần receipt qualification ghi ở upscale.qualified[backend] của ĐÚNG domain đó; recipe SeedVR2 của domain hoạt hình không bao giờ được tra ở đây.

long_take.comment: BP-42 (user 01/11, TAKE_MODE_SELECTOR). NEWTECONS only; a JennieJoy long-take route needs its OWN template in its OWN row. Not measured on GPU: the table of window counts is a reference table from a third-party post, context_length/overlap in the template are guesses. Needs its OWN qualification receipt (the h3 receipt 30cd429b covers only h3-ref2va).
long_take.max_windows_comment: template has 8 prompt slots; fewer windows = unused slots are pruned from the graph (engine/video/longtake.py prune_windows), more than 8 = refused (60 s needs 17 windows: needs a new template).

wardrobe_prompts.comment: User rule 31/10/2026: office AND site container office = van_phong (company shirt, no helmet, no vest); outdoors on site = cong_truong full PPE, helmet WORN. Read by engine/video/plan.py wardrobe_for(); prompt.compose applies rule + drops forbidden script phrases (kept in receipt as provenance).

van_phong.rule: Wardrobe (van_phong, office or site container office): the company fine blue-white grid shirt with the small collar logo only; no helmet, no safety vest, nothing reflective.

cong_truong.rule: Wardrobe (cong_truong, outdoors on site): full PPE over the company shirt; the white safety helmet with the company logo is worn on the head, chin strap fastened, never carried; reflective safety vest on.
cong_truong.rule_with_props: Wardrobe (cong_truong, outdoors on site): full PPE over the company shirt; the white safety helmet with the company logo is worn on the head, chin strap fastened; reflective safety vest on. A helmet the shot declares as a prop is held in hand, not worn.

upscale.comment: `none` = ghi upscale_pending và dừng ở cổng needs-gpu-pilot-approval. Một backend chỉ chạy khi qualified[backend] trỏ tới receipt qualification NEWTECONS (path + sha256) do user cho phép pilot; crop/pad 1944x1080 -> 1920x1080 chưa chốt: `crop_mode` để null cho tới khi user chọn (adapter comfy-realesrgan-1080 từ chối chạy khi null; giá trị hợp lệ v1: center-crop).

wardrobe_policy.comment: No workplace wardrobe context rules are applied. Canonical approved cartoon character references own identity, costume, age, hair, symmetry and accessories.

upscale.comment: Only the existing cartoon SeedVR2 v003 qualification is pinned. It qualifies 864x480 -> 3888x2160 processing, then an exact 24 px left/right crop to 3840x2160; it does not certify full-film seams. The default remains `none` until a SeedVR2 adapter is registered.
